### FAC-330 · Sound transmission between 2F-3 and 2F-4
Requester: noemi.rochat · Opened: 2023-05-11 09:20 · Status: Open (deferred)

Requester reports that conversation in meeting room 2F-3 is clearly audible in office 2F-4, and vice versa.

Facilities assessment (2023-05-19): the partition between 2F-3 and 2F-4 is single-stud with no acoustic insulation — it was erected during the 2019 fit-out to subdivide what was originally one room, and does not extend to the structural deck. Speech at normal conversational volume is intelligible through it. Remediation requires taking the wall back to studs; quoted at CHF 14,200. Deferred pending budget.
